label: original-phase input w/d/0/z/c/f at mid positions
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase, never at t=0, the delimiter, or copy phase. It is driven by the current input token: w (~30% rate, 23% of mass), d, 0, z, c, f carry ~89% of activation mass; s/q/t/digits weakly. Rate peaks at orig positions 3-6 and is near zero at t=1. First occurrences of a token are favoured (in_first 1.7x lift), but requiring in_first lowers F1. Strongest activations come after prefixes of letters like g/y/v/j/h/k/u (first_tok and prev tokens from this set show ~2x lift), and same-set tokens seen earlier tend to suppress it; these history effects are graded and did not give a clean predicate. Precision ~0.57: many w/d/z/c/f inputs do not cross threshold, depending on prior context.
